name: 多支装封箱胶带带座款

category.leaf: 加厚封箱胶带含手持胶带座

description: 纯色块信息图加实拍，打包胶带套图骨架，主张与数值全部留白占位

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white sweep #FFFFFF for packshots, matte kraft corrugated surface #C8A277 for use and spec screens, solid signal-blue #1B87C9 field for infographic and close frames
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio key front-left with fill card, daylight use scenes graded to 5500K from the left, soft contact shadows only, controlled plastic sheen without harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: plain kraft corrugated cartons #C8A277, grey concrete loading floor #B8B2AA, neutral matte board #EFEAE3
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, heavy uppercase display lines in charcoal ink #232323 or #FFFFFF, square-corner color blocks instead of rounded pills, copy always sits in solid panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons plus flat solid curved arrows in #232323 and #1B87C9, blank circular callout discs, no 3D icons
styleLock.presentationRules: packshot unit upright and centred with its circular core facing camera, one consistent slight 3/4 hand-tool angle across the set, stable product scale, tape strip always laid along a carton seam
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or white balance between panels
no brand marks, wordmarks or decorative fabric patterns
no rounded-corner badges or glossy 3D icons
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold primary color-block packing-supply commerce system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, signal blue #1B87C9, hi-chroma yellow #F5C400 and kraft brown #C8A277; neutral temperature with daylight scenes at 5500K; charcoal ink #232323 for all type; square-cornered solid color-block copy panels, never rounded pills; flat single-color header bands and blank circular callout discs with flat curved arrows; thin single-weight line icons only; plain kraft corrugated cartons and concrete surfaces as the only props; stable centred product scale with the roll core facing camera; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no gradient or patterned backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no brand marks or decorative fabric patterns.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用整组多支陈列与陈列盒体量感赢得第一眼的量贩认知
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight 3/4 turn on the front unit, group two rows deep, full silhouette inside frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left key with fill card on the shadow side, crisp soft contact shadows
shots.props: one plain open-front display carton behind the group, no printed artwork
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, tight clean margin around the group silhouette
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A matched group of identical units arranged two rows deep on a seamless pure white sweep #FFFFFF, the front unit upright at a straight-on eye-level view with a slight 3/4 turn so its circular core and hand grip read clearly, the units behind stepping back and rising into very soft focus. A plain open-front carton stands behind them as a display tray with completely blank faces. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and a fill card on the shadow side, short soft contact shadows grounding every single unit. The group occupies 60-70% of the frame with a tight clean margin and no extra whitespace. Rendered at 4K for zoom-level edge clarity. Negative: no added wordmarks, no fabricated logos, no printed artwork on the blank tray, no decorative fabric or diamond pattern anywhere, no text, no hands, no tinted or gradient background, no floating units without contact shadow, no clipped edges, no duplicated handles.

shots.intent: 一秒给出核心利益，用抱箱受力的身体语言暗示封口的承重力
shots.camera: very low angle looking upward at a neck-cropped figure, taped carton on the top line, unit of product on the crate in the lower foreground
shots.lighting: directional daylight from the upper right at 5500K, deeper falloff behind, warm bounce on the forearm, visible contact shadow under the unit
shots.background: dim charcoal loading-bay interior #2A2724 with a blurred carton stack
shots.props: one plain kraft carton and a low wooden crate, both unprinted
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the upper left for one headline block
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A neck-cropped figure in a plain unbranded work shirt hugs a taped kraft carton against the chest, photographed from a very low angle looking upward so the taped seam sits along the top line of the frame, while one unit of {product} rests on a low wooden crate in the lower foreground so the sellable item stays clearly identifiable. Directional daylight from the upper right at 5500K, deeper falloff into the dim charcoal loading-bay interior #2A2724, warm bounce on the forearm, real contact shadow under the unit. The carton, figure and unit together occupy 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space across the upper left, where one square-cornered #F5C400 headline block sits sized for 「{selling_point_1}」 and nothing else is written. Negative: no face or identity, no deformed or extra fingers, no weight numerals or load figures, no strain lines or motion graphics, no brand marks on shirt or carton, no glossy plastic skin, no floating carton without a supporting arm.

shots.intent: 放大运输途中封口弹开、箱体散移的焦虑，逼出换胶带的动机
shots.camera: matched two-panel framing, identical straight-on eye-level camera on both panels, cartons filling the van mouth
shots.lighting: left panel cold flat light, right panel brighter key, both graded consistently so only the carton state differs
shots.background: van interior and grey concrete loading floor #B8B2AA on both panels
shots.props: plain kraft cartons only, one scuffed wrapped parcel on the left panel
shots.whitespace: clean negative space across the top quarter for a header band
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels divided by a single hairline #232323 vertical rule with identical camera and framing. Left panel: a stack of plain kraft cartons shifting apart inside a van mouth, one top flap peeling open and the tape end lifting, cold flat light, scuffed wrapped parcel, grey concrete loading floor #B8B2AA. Right panel: the same stack holding square and flush with a clean sealed strip of {product} laid across every seam, brighter even key, and the unit of {product} standing on the tailgate at a slight 3/4. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Both panels graded to the same 5500K so only the carton state changes. Cartons and unit occupy 40-50% of each panel with clean negative space across the top quarter. Negative: no peeling tape printed with any pattern or wordmark, no vehicle livery or carrier marks, no numbers or percentages or damage statistics, no dense body text, no hands, no faces, no mismatched light direction between panels, no watermark.

shots.intent: 让人代入自己打包的那一刻，顺手把三条卖点排成可扫读的要点栏
shots.camera: photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, laid strip running diagonally across frame
shots.lighting: soft natural window daylight from the left at 5500K with a warm bounce, gentle contact shadow under the hand, glossy strip against matte board
shots.background: matte kraft corrugated carton surface #C8A277 with a second carton out of focus behind
shots.props: one extra stacked carton behind, nothing covering the cutter
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left third for the bullet panel
shots.textZone: left square-cornered #1B87C9 panel with three blank label slots 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle use scene: a single hand pressing a hand-held unit of {product} along the centre seam of a kraft corrugated carton, the freshly laid strip running diagonally across the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down so both the grip and the seam are legible at once. Soft natural window daylight from the left at 5500K with a warm bounce card, gentle contact shadow under the hand, the laid strip reading glossy against the matte board #C8A277, a second stacked carton falling out of focus behind. The hand and unit occupy 40-50% of the frame with generous negative space on the left third, where one square-cornered #1B87C9 panel carries three blank bullet slots reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」. Negative: no deformed or extra fingers, no visible face or identity, no nail-styling detail that reads as a specific person, no brand marks on the unit, no numbers or measurements, no props covering the cutter edge.

shots.intent: 用齿刃与带头贴合度的微距证据说明做工，替掉口头材质承诺
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, photographed from above at a shallow skim, tight zoom on the cutter teeth and the free strip end, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: sweeping skimming light from the right revealing film thickness, edge lift and corrugation pores, one restrained highlight along each tooth
shots.background: neutral matte board #EFEAE3 falling to a kraft seam in the lower band
shots.whitespace: minimal whitespace, the texture itself is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the serrated cutter teeth and the free end of a laid strip meeting the corrugated flute of a kraft seam. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from above at a shallow skim with a macro lens and shallow depth of field, the teeth and strip edge razor sharp while everything behind falls away. A sweeping skimming light from the right reveals film thickness, edge lift and the pores of the cardboard with one restrained highlight along each tooth. Neutral matte board #EFEAE3 in the upper band over the kraft seam below. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace. Rendered at 4K. Negative: no blurry subject, no duplicated or melted cutter teeth, no lettering or pattern inside the macro field, no painted-on fibre tears, no dust specks that read as mould, no hands, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用同框同机位的双栏线稿对照讲清封口手法差异，把用量疑虑转成方法教学
shots.camera: flat top-down 90-degree infographic plate, two matched cartons at identical 3/4 isometric tilt
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow, illustration-safe
shots.props: two line-drawn cartons only, one blank header band, one divider rule
shots.whitespace: broad even white margin around both panels
shots.textZone: top solid #1B87C9 header band 「{selling_point_2}」 plus one blank label slot under each panel 「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison infographic plate, flat top-down 90-degree view on a seamless white field #FFFFFF, two matched plain cartons drawn in the same clean 3/4 isometric line style at identical tilt, divided by one hairline #232323 vertical rule. Left carton shows a single strip of tape laid across its top seam, right carton shows the same tape laid in an H pattern across both seams and edges, drawn as solid flat shapes in #1B87C9 with #F5C400 end tabs. {product} appears once, small and photographic, standing centred at the very bottom edge of the plate so the real item anchors the diagram. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting with no dramatic shadow. The two drawn cartons together occupy 35-40% of the frame with broad even white margins. A solid #1B87C9 header band across the top is sized for one short headline 「{selling_point_2}」 and one blank label slot sits under each carton reading 「{callout_4}」 and 「{callout_5}」. Negative: no photographs mixed into the line style, no counts of boxes or roll lengths or any other numerals, no diamond or fabric pattern on the drawn tape, no perspective mismatch between the two cartons, no dense body text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 把紧凑款与标准款同框并置，替买家自行判断尺寸与握持差异
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile of both units at identical eye level on a kraft tabletop
shots.lighting: even high-key studio light from the front-left, short soft contact shadows, controlled matte plastic sheen
shots.background: matte kraft corrugated tabletop #C8A277 with a blurred carton stack behind
shots.props: one blurred plain carton stack behind both units, two blank discs and two flat arrows
shots.whitespace: wide clear headroom above both units for the header band
shots.textZone: two blank #1B87C9 discs 「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」 and one blank slot under each unit 「{callout_8}」「{callout_9}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce spec comparison screen: two sizes of {product} placed in a clean 90-degree side profile on a matte kraft corrugated tabletop #C8A277, the compact unit standing upright and the larger roll unit tipped so its circular core reads as a full disc, both sitting at exactly the same eye level with a blurred plain carton stack behind. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key studio light from the front-left, short soft contact shadows directly beneath each unit, controlled matte plastic sheen with no blown highlights. The two units occupy 50-60% of the frame with wide clear headroom above. Two blank solid #1B87C9 circles flank the pair, sized for 「{callout_6}」 and 「{callout_7}」, joined to the units by two flat #232323 curved arrows, and one blank label slot sits under each unit reading 「{callout_8}」 and 「{callout_9}」. Negative: no dimension numerals, no unit abbreviations, no capacity or length figures, no brand wordmark, no diamond pattern on either label face, no mismatched white balance between the two units, no drifting scale between them, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用小址与大址两条生活路径引导买家自选件数，把套装决策交给图片
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level product centred over two equal flanking photo panels
shots.lighting: both photo panels graded to the same 5500K daylight with consistent shadow direction from the left
shots.background: solid signal-blue field #1B87C9 acting as the frame around two photo panels
shots.props: plain cartons in both panels, one unprinted display header band
shots.whitespace: tight blue gutter margins, no extra whitespace inside the photo panels
shots.textZone: one blank quantity slot inside each panel 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 under a solid header band
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant chooser screen: {product} standing upright and centred at a straight-on eye-level view, floating over the seam between two equal flanking photo panels set inside a solid signal-blue #1B87C9 frame. Left panel: two workers in plain unbranded shirts handing blank kraft cartons up into a lit van, full body from behind. Right panel: a neck-cropped household carrying cartons toward a doorway, adults only, faces cropped out of frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Both panels graded to the same 5500K daylight with the shadow direction consistently from the left so they read as one shoot. The two panels plus the unit occupy 60-70% of the frame with tight blue gutter margins. A solid header band across the top and one blank quantity slot inside the lower corner of each panel carry 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 as the only text furniture. Negative: no identifiable faces, no child faces or recognisable children, no roll counts or numbers of any kind, no vehicle livery or building signage, no brand marks on the unit, no mismatched white balance between panels, no hands covering the product, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用一张结构化的留白资质卡承接信任位，真实文字后期合成而非生成
shots.camera: dead-frontal straight-on view of the card, product at a slight 3/4 in the lower corner
shots.lighting: even clean high-key studio light, one faint card shadow to the lower right
shots.props: one offset yellow plate and one hairline outline frame, no artwork inside
shots.whitespace: generous white margin on all four sides
shots.textZone: three empty text rules and one blank seal box inside the card, deliberately no glyphs
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen: a single bold credential card lying dead-frontal on a seamless white field #FFFFFF, built from one solid #F5C400 plate offset behind a #232323 hairline rectangular outline frame, containing three empty charcoal text rules and one blank seal box in the lower right, all of them deliberately empty placeholder furniture with no rendered glyphs. {product} shown small at a slight 3/4 in the lower left corner of the card so the sellable item stays present. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even clean high-key studio lighting with one faint card shadow falling to the lower right. The card occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous white margin on all four sides. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, origin claims, standards marks, lab results, serial numbers, barcodes or ratings; no flags or national symbols; no readable words inside the card; no wordmark block; no gold foil or glossy emboss effects; no drop shadow lifting the card off the field; no watermark.

shots.intent: 收口把发货搬家仓储三条用途串成一次浏览，留出行动位完成转化
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level on the product, three stacked photo panels in a right-hand column
shots.lighting: all three panels graded to the same 5500K daylight with shadow direction from the left
shots.background: solid signal-blue field #1B87C9 with a yellow sub-band
shots.props: plain cartons in all three panels, one blank action slot
shots.whitespace: clean negative space filling the left half for the headline block
shots.textZone: left headline block 「{selling_point_3}」, one #F5C400 sub-band and one blank action slot beneath it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close: a solid signal-blue #1B87C9 field carrying one heavy headline block on the left sized for 「{selling_point_3}」, a short #F5C400 sub-band under it and one blank action slot at its foot, beside a right-hand column of three equal stacked photo panels. Top panel: a blank kraft carton passed hand to hand at a doorway. Middle panel: an open car boot filled with plain cartons. Bottom panel: a neck-cropped figure shelving a carton inside a self-storage unit, shot from behind. {product} standing at the foot of the panel column at a slight 3/4 with a soft contact shadow. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera on the product, all three panels graded to the same 5500K daylight with shadow direction consistently from the left. The panel column plus product occupy 50-60% of the frame, the left half kept as clean negative space for the headline block. Negative: no countdown timers, no invented discounts, prices or percentage signs, no carrier or shipping-company marks on cartons or vehicles, no identifiable faces, no deformed fingers during the hand-off, no roll counts, no mismatched white balance between panels, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：源 10 张方图。第 1 张白底多支手持胶带座与陈列盒群像加纯色块大字；第 2 张手部压胶带座沿纸箱接缝施胶，左侧纯色块排三条要点；第 3 张白底双栏线稿纸箱对照两种封箱手法，顶部色带标题与底注；第 4 张牛皮纸台面上两款胶带座并置，圆形气泡加弯箭头指规格差异；第 5 张蓝色底框内两组实拍（装厢与家庭搬家）加中央单品，两侧各一个件数位；第 6 张厢货后门内堆叠纸箱受压擦伤；第 7 张颈下裁切人物抱已封箱，黄色大字承重主张；第 8 张低角度户外落箱砸向已封纸箱；第 9 张蓝底左要右三格竖排场景实拍加黄底副标块；第 10 张白底黄板加黑细框资质卡。品类判定：图为封箱胶带与手持胶带座的办公打包耗材，中文电商归文具耗材线，故取 电脑办公／办公文具；未取 家居日用（无清洁收纳器具属性）、未取 家装灯具／五金（无电动与五金件）。与源提示的类目方向一致，仅细分以 taxonomy 表内字符串逐字命中。已剥离：原品牌字标与制造商标记、其菱形格纹商标图案、全部图内英文原句与承诺句、承重与内径与卷长与可封箱数与件数等一切具体数值、原产国与全球采购类资质主张、平台促销与评价类社会证明角标、可识别人物面容与身份；数量与主张一律改为空白色块占位槽与 {callout_n}、{selling_point_n}，产品一律 {product} 占位。
